facts.text: Matfield Green sprang up in the late 1850s when English immigrant David Washington Mercer named the prairie settlement after the village green in Kent, England.
The Crocker Ranch, one of only two ranches listed on the National Register of Historic Places in Matfield Green, showcases early 20th‑century stone barns.
Since 2001, the Pioneer Bluffs Foundation has worked at the historic Rogler Ranch to preserve ranching heritage and restore prairie ecosystems.
Before settlers arrived, the area that is now Matfield Green was home to Native American peoples for roughly 12,000 years, hunting big game and gathering plants.
Matfield Green is officially a city within Chase County, Kansas, United States.
